$comment: Advisories that are known, assessed and deliberately still here. Read by scripts/check-advisories.mjs.
An entry is a dated decision, not a suppression: when recheckAfter passes, the gate fails until
a human looks again. Deleting an entry whose advisory is gone is required, not optional, because
an acceptance that matches nothing reads as a live risk assessment.
The full reasoning for each entry lives in docs/security-notes.md. Keep the two in step.

accepted.reason: Bundled inside aws-cdk-lib, which names minimatch in bundleDependencies, so npm never re-resolves it and an overrides entry cannot reach it. Measured: adding the override left the nested copy at 5.0.8. No released aws-cdk-lib bundles the fixed 5.0.9 yet. Reachable only at synthesis time on a developer machine or in CI, never in Lambda and never in the request path, over glob patterns this repository wrote itself.

ReDoS in the CORS middleware. Fixed in 4.12.34, published 2026-08-03, which is inside the min-release-age cooldown this repository sets in .npmrc. The cooldown is not bypassed to clear a finding faster. No HTTP surface is mounted yet, which is a fact about today rather than a mitigation.
